An experienced martial fighter; the listed level and source equipment guide the combat silhouette. Source inventory: Javelin +1, Two-handed sword +2, Chain armor +1. Readied: Two-handed sword +2, Chain armor +1. Source wealth: 15 cp.

Input Image 1 is the NEW ready draft of this fighter with the correct LEFT-OF-HEAD throwing hand and the silver javelin tip facing right. Edit this image in place; it is the exact identity, body, armor, scale, stance and LEFT throwing-arm pose to retain. Input Image 2 is a nearest-neighbor 128x128 export of Image 1 showing the intended canvas coordinates and planted feet. Input Image 3 is the approved independent bipedal pose guide for front three-quarter screen-right facing only; do not copy its character or weapons. No original game artwork is attached.
FIX ONLY THE JAVELIN'S BALANCE AND ANGLE. In the current draft, the hand left of the head grips near the REAR THIRD of an almost horizontal javelin. It must grip the exact MIDDLE of one full-length javelin. Keep the same raised throwing hand around native export coordinate x47,y27, and keep its same visible arm emerging from the SCREEN-LEFT SHOULDER. Reposition the wooden shaft and silver metal-capped point around that stationary grip: the rear wooden butt points down-left near x20,y52; the pointed silver metal end points UP-RIGHT near x74,y2. The straight continuous shaft passes THROUGH the hand at its midpoint, with roughly equal visible shaft lengths on each side of the gripping hand. The metal-capped pointed end is on the RIGHT, never on the left. The spear rises steeply toward screen right above the head, a natural overhand throwing guard; it must still read as a long JAVELIN +1, not a short sword, staff or second weapon.
Keep the fighter's dark hair, face, chain armor +1, red waist cloth, belt, complete torso, offhand bent at chest, hips, legs and boots unchanged. Preserve the same body size, camera, 1x1 sprite footprint and exact planted-foot x/y coordinates of Image 1. The offhand remains empty. Do not change the raised throwing arm's shoulder identity, hand position, grip anatomy, or the man's front three-quarter screen-right facing. No other limb, body, armor, palette, or background change is requested. The raised javelin alone may pass into the square above; keep it inside the 128x128 PNG with transparent margin and within the one-square side boundaries.
Exactly one full-body fighter, one READY frame, one javelin with the metal point UP-RIGHT, no action frame, duplicate, diptych, sheet, bow, sword, shield, arrow, magic, scenery, floor, caption, marker, black box or opaque background. Crisp readable pixel art and genuine transparency.
